decision_reason: The recovered source supports an explicitly attributed organizational estimate based on 317 reviewed cases; it is not independently verified, the original study document was not located, and the separate rubble-missing estimate remains distinct.

attribution_assessment.attributed_to: Palestinian Center for Missing and Forcibly Disappeared Persons, reported by Anadolu Agency
attribution_assessment.safe_future_wording: Anadolu reported that the Palestinian Center reviewed 317 documented or family-reported cases and estimated that 2,500 to 3,000 people may have been forcibly disappeared; the estimate was not independently verified, the original study document was not located, and the separate 4,000-5,000 rubble-missing estimate remains distinct.

evidence_references.supporting_passage: Anadolu reported that the rights group reviewed 317 documented or family-reported cases and estimated 2,500-3,000 possible enforced disappearances, separately from an estimate of 4,000-5,000 people believed missing under rubble.
